description.narrative: The purpose of this Action is twofold: to strengthen sector policy making and to support the implementation of the national employment, education and social inclusion strategies.This will contribute to reducing the high rate of unemployment, increasing labour market participation, in particular of young people and women, increasing access to quality education and training, improving skills matches and establishing a modern and flexible social protection system.
